fields.summary: Let eld-1 only be applied to snapshot, not differential
fields.customfield_10618:
Will move eld-1 from ElementDefinition to StructureDefinition.snapshot.

This resolve will break an existing rule at "https://build.fhir.org/versions.html#change" which states

"The allowed list of Data types will not be added, removed or changed. Invariants, regular expressions, fixed values and patterns will not be added, removed or changed. "

 

This change highlight the need to relax value constraints.

 

We will change the text to:

" The allowed list of Data types may be extended, but not constrained. Invariants, regular expressions, fixed values and patterns will not be added, removed but may be relaxed. "
fields.description:
Current situation:
 * Given a resource 1 with slicing on element A
 * And a resource 2 derived from resource 1, which:
 * Makes a change to slicing of element A (eg. changing closed to open slicing)
 * And does not repeat the discriminator in element A
 * eld-1 fires, complaining element A in resource 2 does not have a discriminator set.

Proposal: Make eld-1 only applicable to the snapshot part of a resource, eliminating the need to repeat all slicing information in a derived resource.

[https://www.hl7.org/fhir/profiling.html#reslicing] is already clear the discriminator inherits to the child resources:
{quote}If a discriminator for an element is declared in a parent profile, child profiles referencing that element: SHALL include all the same discriminators
{quote}
_Reported from Zulip topic [Is eld-1 correct in the context of an differential?|https://chat.fhir.org/#narrow/stream/179177/topic/Is%20eld-1%20correct%20in%20the%20context%20of%20an%20differential%3F/near/1614779648] with Firely Bot._
